info.title: API.SH: Telegram
info.description: The Telegram API from API.SH: public Telegram data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
A public channel's media, newest first: photos, videos (with thumbnails and durations), files, voice notes and links (with the link preview title and site), grouped by post with the post id, link, date, text and views. Reads up to `pages` pages of posts per call. Pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor`; null at the start of the channel.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/telegram-channel-media

parameters.name: handle
parameters.description: A channel username or t.me link.

parameters.name: pages
parameters.description: Pages of 20 posts to read per call (1-5, default 3).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
20 posts per page, newest first. `next_cursor` goes to older posts (null at the channel's first post); with `after` or `cursor`, `previous_cursor` goes newer. Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/telegram-channel-posts

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search the channel (Telegram's own search); pages with the same cursor.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Value of `next_cursor` from the previous page.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Message id: return the posts newer than it (use previous_cursor to keep going newer).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Comments on a channel post, from the post's public discussion (the comments button under channel posts), newest first, about 50 per page. Pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor` for older comments; it is null at the first comment. Each comment has its author (name, username, photo), text, date, the comment it replies to, reactions and photos. Posts whose channel has no public discussion answer `comments_enabled: false` with an empty list. Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/telegram-post-comments

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Value of `next_cursor` from the previous page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
